summary: Keep native stui terminals on the daemon's ordered shared geometry to avoid stale or duplicated rows during resize

replay.detail: No stored event replay changes. Native terminal attachment now applies the initial effective geometry before feeding the screen replay.

schema.detail: No database schema or replicated claim change.

rules.detail: Pane resize requests no longer resize the local emulators ahead of queued output. Only daemon GEOMETRY frames change effective dimensions, preserving DATA ordering and constraints from other attached clients.

compatibility.detail: Uses existing PTY GEOMETRY frames and SessionConnection effective dimension accessors; no wire protocol change.

downtime.detail: No daemon restart is required for this client-only change; reopen stui to use the updated viewer.

manual.detail: No migration or manual action is required.
